description: This PHP class defines a template for a drag-and-drop chooser interface within the SuiteCRM platform. It extends a base Template class and provides methods to generate HTML and JavaScript for a multi-column drag-and-drop data grid, including dynamic data encoding and script generation for client-side interactions.

classes.name: TemplateDragDropChooser
classes.description: A PHP class that provides a drag-and-drop multi-column template interface for SuiteCRM, allowing dynamic data display and client-side interactivity.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates HTML and JavaScript code for rendering the drag-and-drop interface, optionally returning an array of HTML segments if 'return_array' argument is set.

methods.name: displayDefinitionScript
methods.description: Produces JavaScript code that defines the client-side class handling the drag-and-drop grid behavior, including initialization and sorting.

methods.name: displayScriptTags
methods.description: Returns the necessary CSS and JavaScript tags to include YUI components and styles needed for the template interface.
